hooks.command: d=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); u=$(git log @{u}..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); m=""; [ "$d" -gt 0 ] && m="$d uncommitted file(s)"; [ "$u" -gt 0 ] && m="${m:+$m, }$u unpushed commit(s)"; [ -n "$m" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Git reminder: %s - not yet saved to GitHub. Ask Claude to commit and push."}\n' "$m"; exit 0
